policy.eligibility: Whole authenticated aligned stage2 universe; paired exact anchor PS and inherited depth QC. No observed-sign, tie, effect-size, individual-ASM, recurrence, GO or preselected-hit selection.
policy.individual_test: Two-sided exact equal-OR conditional test with probability ordering over the full fixed-margin support. No sign conditioning, pseudocount or mid-P.
policy.recurrence: Fisher partial conjunction of all paired-animal OR P values, r=2..N, separately for each of three tissue pairs.
policy.primary_q: BH over the entire eligible N>=r CpG family for each tissue pair and r. Cross-CpG independence/appropriate positive-dependence assumptions remain.
policy.robust_q: BY over the same complete family, reported as a separate dependence sensitivity. Do not choose the smaller correction.
policy.effect: ALT-minus-REF fraction at one common SNP anchor, paired first-minus-second signed difference. Mean and median are descriptive, not the OR-test estimand.
policy.missing: Unaligned or absent is unavailable, never zero. Keep all aligned paired animals, including zero and opposing effects. No PS pooling.
policy.resource: All allowed CPUs subject to job RAM estimates; reserve 2 percent total RAM plus 2 GiB, disk 20 GiB, native math threads 1.
policy.families: 27 separate pair-by-r families. No union/max-r FDR, no ALL3 test, no general minimum-N validation.
